cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Znalosti biotických původců chorob dřevin, příčin infekce a schopnost komplexního posouzení příčin chřadnutí dřevin. Schopnost identifikovat původce choroby a jeho úloha v patogenezi. Obsahově je předmět zaměřen na: definice původců chorob dřevin, symptomatika, bionomie patogena, koincidence s dalšími faktory, invazivní organismy, karanténní organismy, fytogeografie, hniloby, choroby kořenů, choroby kambia, choroby asimilačního aparátu, choroby letorostů. Hlavní témata: 1. Symptomatika, Predispoziční faktory. 2. Rozklad dřeva dřevokaznými houbami. 3. Choroby semen. 4. Choroby semenáčků a sazenic, Choroby dřevin ve školkách. 5. Choroby kořenů. 6. Choroby kmene. 7. Choroby asimilačního aparátu. 8. Dřevní houby. 9. Vaskulární mykózy. 10. Choroby listnáčů. 11. Choroby konifer. 12. Karanténní choroby.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Knowledge of biotic agents of tree diseases, causes of infection and the ability to comprehensively assess the causes of tree decline. Ability to identify the disease agent and its role in pathogenesis. The content of the course focuses on: definitions of woody plant disease agents, symptomatology, pathogen bionomy, co-incidence with other factors, invasive organisms, quarantine organisms, phytogeography, decay, root diseases, cambium diseases, diseases of the assimilative apparatus, diseases of annuals. Main topics: 1. Symptomatics, Predisposing factors. 2. Decomposition of wood by wood-destroying fungi. 3. Diseases of seeds. 4. Diseases of seedlings and saplings, Diseases of nursery trees. 5. Root diseases. 6. Trunk diseases. 7. Diseases of the assimilative apparatus. 8. Wood fungi. 9. Vascular mycoses. 10. Diseases of deciduous trees. 11. Diseases of conifers. 12. Quarantine diseases. Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)To introduce the causes of diseases, disorders or damage to woody plants and the stressors that cause them. To explain the pattern and possible impacts of climate change. To learn to determine the effects of stresses by the symptoms they cause or by the fungal agents and to learn to apply appropriate means of defence. To learn about the basic set of insect pests on woody plants and the important insect species for biodiversity.
